title: Prompt Package
description: Provider-ready prompt for one shot (production/prompts/ or production/scenes/<SC_ID>/prompts/<provider>/). Compiled from the shot, the bibles, and the reference plan — never freehanded. Providers' compile() consumes this shape.

id.description: Package ID: PP_<shot>_<PROVIDER-TAG> for shot packages (e.g. PP_SH_004_002_VEO), or PP_<asset-id>_<PROVIDER-TAG> for asset-scoped packages such as masters (e.g. PP_CHAR_MARA_EXPRESSION_HARNESS-NATIVE).

shot.description: Shot this package generates; null for asset-scoped packages (masters, reference sheets), which set asset instead.

asset.description: Asset this package generates (asset-scoped packages); omit for shot packages.

provider.description: Target provider ID (must exist in the provider manifests).

prompt.description: Full prompt text, compiled in the provider's preferred phrasing.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt for providers that support one.

parameters.description: Generation parameters. Provider-specific extras are allowed; validate.js checks the typed fields against the provider's capabilities.

duration_seconds.description: Requested clip length; must be within the provider's maxDurationSeconds.

seed.description: Fixed seed for reproducibility; omit to let the provider pick.

references.description: Resolved reference images, in submission order, from the reference plan.

role.description: What the image conditions; mirrors reference-plan purpose.

image_path.description: Path to the actual image file submitted to the provider.

start_frame.description: Path to the start keyframe image, or null if not (yet) generated.

end_frame.description: Path to the end keyframe image, or null if not (yet) generated.

status.description: draft = human-editable; compiled = frozen output of compile-prompts.js; submitted = sent to the provider.

source_hashes.description: Content hashes of the inputs this package was compiled from; a mismatch means the package is stale and must be recompiled.
